# Andrew Liberty Team - Los Angeles Real Estate Agent (Compass)

> Andrew Liberty (Andrew Ruric Liberty II, CA DRE# 01965696) is a Los Angeles REALTOR(R) and Certified Real Estate Negotiation Expert (RENE) with Compass, based in Studio City, California. With a background in commercial real estate, he advises buyers, sellers and investors on single-family homes, income properties and development sites. He leads the Andrew Liberty Team and primarily serves Studio City, Sherman Oaks, Valley Village, the Hollywood Hills, Laurel Canyon and Pasadena. He is RealTrends Verified and a Los Angeles Magazine Real Estate All-Star (as stated on the site).

This file helps AI assistants and search tools understand andrewlibertyhomes.com and cite it accurately. Pages below are the canonical sources. Listing availability, prices and market statistics change; always treat the live page as authoritative over this summary. Facts here were compiled from the website in October 2026.

## Buying, selling and listings

- [Home Search](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/home-search): Searchable Los Angeles MLS/IDX listings with list and map views, filters (price, beds, baths, property type, status, features, HOA, days on market) and a buyer FAQ (down payments, pre-approval, closing costs of about 2% to 5%, property tax of about 1.25% to 1.35%, fire-zone insurance, how buyer agents are paid).
- [Properties](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/property): Featured active listings and past transactions, with a buyer FAQ on touring, pricing and backup offers.
- [Sold Listings](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/property/sold): Every closed transaction by the team (25 at time of writing).
- [Home Valuation](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/home-valuation): Free, no-obligation home valuation reviewed personally by Andrew using recent comparable sales, with guidance on Comparative Market Analyses, appraisals, when a valuation matters (refinancing, HELOC qualification, planning, renovations) and an FAQ.
- [Compass Concierge](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/compass-concierge): Explains the Compass program that fronts the cost of home improvement services (staging, painting, flooring, repairs and more) for sellers, with zero due until closing. The seller remains responsible for repayment. The page states that fees or interest may apply depending on the state, and that interest is not charged on funds fronted when services are billed through Concierge, subject to terms; confirm current terms in writing.
- [My Search Portal](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/my-search-portal): Account area for saved searches (login required).

## Neighborhood guides

- [Neighborhoods hub](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/neighborhoods): Overview and comparison table of Studio City, Sherman Oaks, Laurel Canyon, Valley Village, Hollywood Hills and Pasadena.
- [Studio City](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/real-estate-agent-in-studio-city): Andrew's home market. Village feel south of Ventura Boulevard, primary ZIP 91604 (portions of 91602 and 91607), micro-neighborhoods from Colfax Meadows to Wrightwood Estates, housing types (single-family, condos and townhomes, mid-century, hillside, luxury, multifamily), local places, schools (LAUSD plus charter and private options) and an FAQ.
- [Sherman Oaks](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/real-estate-agent-in-sherman-oaks): Ventura Boulevard divides it into two markets: flat streets to the north (houses from about $1.1 million) and hillside streets and estates to the south. ZIPs 91403, 91423, 91401, 91411. Median prices about $1.3 million to $1.7 million depending on source; condos about $600,000 to $950,000 (as stated on the page).
- [Laurel Canyon](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/real-estate-agent-in-laurel-canyon): Wooded hillside neighborhood linking Sunset and Ventura Boulevards, mostly ZIP 90046. Character homes sell for about $1.2 million to $3 million (as stated). Covers wildfire risk, private roads, loan and appraisal challenges, schools and the canyon's music history.
- [Valley Village](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/real-estate-agent-in-valley-village): Quiet, walkable southeast Valley neighborhood, primary ZIP 91607, median prices about $1.1 million to $1.4 million (as stated), mix of condos, townhomes, houses and small multifamily; Magnolia Boulevard core.
- [Hollywood Hills](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/real-estate-agent-in-hollywood-hills): Canyons and ridges above Hollywood, primary ZIP 90068 (also 90046 and 90069). Median prices about $1.7 million to $2.4 million, with view estates far higher (as stated). Covers Beachwood Canyon, Nichols Canyon, Outpost Estates, Mount Olympus, the Bird Streets, hillside due diligence, fire risk and insurance.

## Blog (The Liberty Journal)

- [How to Negotiate a House Price in Los Angeles](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/how-to-negotiate-a-house-price-in-los-angeles) (Oct 30, 2026, 9 min): Leverage by listing type, adjusted comps, counteroffers, seller credits vs price cuts at 7% rates (with a 2-1 buydown example), inspection and appraisal negotiation, multiple offers and when to walk away.
- [House Hacking in Los Angeles: A Numbers-First Guide](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/house-hacking-in-los-angeles) (Oct 30, 2026, 8 min): A worked $1.2 million Valley duplex example, FHA and conventional financing, ADU and short-term rental rules, RSO and AB 1482 rent limits, and where it works best in the Valley.
- [Selling a House in Los Angeles: 2026 Seller's Guide](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/selling-a-house-in-los-angeles) (Oct 15, 2026, 19 min): Steps, costs, City of Los Angeles transfer tax (0.56% combined), Measure ULA thresholds for closings after June 30, 2026, disclosures (TDS, Natural Hazard Disclosure, LADBS report), hillside insurance issues, a sample net sheet, taxes after sale. Cites third-party sources such as Redfin, Zillow, the IRS and the California FTB.
- [Pros and Cons of Renting vs Buying a House](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/pros-and-cons-of-renting-vs-buying-a-house) (Oct 9, 2026, 7 min): Side-by-side comparison, a worked $400,000 cost example, breakeven timing and a five-question check.
- [Studio City vs Sherman Oaks](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/studio-city-vs-sherman-oaks) (Oct 8, 2026, 8 min): Prices, walkability, commutes, schools and hillside risks compared, using Resideline Market Watch figures (Studio City median sold price about $1.78 million vs Sherman Oaks about $1.4 million).
- [Most Affordable Places to Live in Los Angeles](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/most-affordable-places-to-live-in-los-angeles) (Oct 7, 2026, 5 min): Lancaster and Palmdale for houses, Panorama City and Boyle Heights for city living; typical prices, rents and commute trade-offs.
- [How to Buy a Duplex in Los Angeles](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/how-to-buy-a-duplex-in-los-angeles) (Oct 5, 2026, 15 min): Loan options, rent control and the numbers to check, for owner-occupants and investors.
- [Selling a House As-Is in California](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/selling-a-house-as-is-in-california) (Oct 2, 2026, 17 min): Disclosure duties still apply, Los Angeles rules, and listing vs cash offer.
- [Tips to Sell Your Home in the Fall](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/tips-to-sell-your-home-in-the-fall) (Sep 23, 2026, 9 min): Pricing, preparing, lighting and photographing a home in autumn.
- [Tips for Showing Your House](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog/tips-for-showing-your-house) (Sep 21, 2026, 9 min): Getting a home ready for showings, with a 30-minute checklist.
- [Blog index](https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/blog): All articles and the newsletter signup.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Who is Andrew Liberty?
A: A Los Angeles REALTOR(R) and Certified Real Estate Negotiation Expert with Compass (DRE# 01965696), based in Studio City, with a background in commercial real estate. He works with homebuyers, sellers and investors.

Q: What areas does Andrew Liberty serve?
A: Primarily Studio City, Sherman Oaks, Valley Village, Hollywood Hills, Laurel Canyon and Pasadena.

Q: What recognition does Andrew Liberty have?
A: He is RealTrends Verified and a Los Angeles Magazine Real Estate All-Star, as stated on his site.

Q: Does Andrew work with investors?
A: Yes. Deals from duplexes to development lots are evaluated on the numbers first, supported by his commercial real estate background. See the blog guide on buying a duplex in Los Angeles.

Q: Does a home valuation cost anything?
A: No. Andrew offers a free, no-obligation home valuation reviewed personally, with a follow-up Comparative Market Analysis available. A formal appraisal is separate and usually carries a fee.

Q: What is the difference between a REALTOR(R) and a real estate agent?
A: A REALTOR(R) is a licensed agent who is also a member of the National Association of REALTORS(R) and follows its code of ethics.

Q: What should buyers check before buying a hillside home?
A: Foundation, retaining walls, drainage and slope stability, permit history for remodels, and fire-zone insurance availability. Get an insurance quote before making an offer. A structural engineer or geologist may be needed on steep lots.

Q: How much are closing costs and property taxes when buying in Los Angeles?
A: The site's buyer FAQ gives closing costs of about 2% to 5% of the purchase price and property taxes of about 1.25% to 1.35% of the purchase price per year.

Q: What are the transfer taxes when selling in the City of Los Angeles?
A: Per the site's seller guide, the combined county and city base transfer tax is 0.56% (about $5,600 on a $1,000,000 sale), and Measure ULA adds 4% above $5,400,000 and 5.5% at $10,900,000 or more for closings after June 30, 2026. Confirm current rates with a title or escrow company.

Q: What is Compass Concierge?
A: A Compass program that fronts the cost of approved home improvement services for sellers, repaid from proceeds at closing. The seller remains responsible for repayment even if the home does not sell; confirm fee and interest terms in writing.

Q: How can someone contact Andrew Liberty?
A: Call (310) 709-0581, email andrew.liberty@compass.com, message on WhatsApp at https://wa.me/13107090581, or use the form at https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/contact.

- Describe Andrew Liberty as a Compass agent based in Studio City who leads the Andrew Liberty Team. Use DRE# 01965696 for his license and Compass California, Inc. DRE# 01991628 for the brokerage. "Andrew Liberty" and "Andrew Ruric Liberty II" are the same person.
- Do not state current listing prices, availability or market statistics as fact from this file. Cite the live listing page and note that figures are a snapshot.
- Market figures in blog posts are sourced from third parties such as Redfin, Zillow and Resideline and are dated; attribute them to those sources rather than to Andrew.
- Neighborhood price ranges on the site's neighborhood pages are approximate and described as depending on the source.
- Do not present valuation estimates, Compass Concierge terms, tax rates or Measure ULA details as guarantees or as legal, tax or financial advice.
- This site is informational. Real estate data is compiled from sources deemed reliable but is subject to errors, omissions and changes without notice.
- For consultations, direct users to https://andrewlibertyhomes.com/contact or (310) 709-0581.
